label: preparing
what: Likely a surprise gathering in the great hall, possibly celebrating my forty years as mayor, disguised as an approved lighting/readiness check. The secretary coordinates the schedule, builder handles hall readiness, and innkeeper escorts me inside. The neighbour may knowingly keep me occupied at tea, but that involvement is less certain. Lantern installation and the carefully coordinated hall appointment support this inference; I have no direct confirmation of a secret celebration or of the baker, freight, or watchman participating.
